Hear from Our Clients
Hear from Our Clients
HCLTech has been a strategic partner, delivering critical engineering services that have significantly contributed to Teradyne’s success. HCLTech’s engineering teams have been integral to Teradyne’s product development, sustenance and support. Our collaboration has spanned multiple platforms, including UltraFLEXplus, UltraFLEX, J750 and ETS. To further strengthen this partnership, HCLTech has established dedicated Teradyne labs in India, equipped with Teradyne testers to support training and development efforts.
Roy Chorev
VP Semiconductor Test, Product Development at Teradyne, Inc.
We’ve built a very strong partnership with HCLTech. Our plan is to take this relationship to the next level by making our Digital IT the best in class, and we appreciate HCLTech for all their efforts and collaboration in making that happen.
Keiki Ka
Global CIO
HCLTech is a true collaborator and a true partner. The way they work and their values resonate with any organization looking to be purpose-led. For me, that passion and what they bring to the table is actually the magic that happens.
Kari-Anne Clayton
Head of Strategy, Transformation,
Service Management and Risk, Retail Banking
You need to choose the right partner who is willing to go the extra mile and embark on this [digital transformation] journey with you, and we’re fortunate to have been partners with HCLTech for over a decade now.
